_profileUploadHint.title: Profile ZIP files
_profileUploadHint.text: Recommended: upload Home Connect profile ZIP files in the ioBroker Files tab to 0_userdata.0/homeconnect-lokal-zip. The matching container path is /opt/iobroker/iobroker-data/files/0_userdata.0/homeconnect-lokal-zip and is used as the default profile directory. Restart this adapter instance after uploading new ZIP files so the profiles are scanned again.

profilePath.label: Profile directory path
profilePath.help: Absolute container path to a directory containing Home Connect profile ZIP files. Default: /opt/iobroker/iobroker-data/files/0_userdata.0/homeconnect-lokal-zip. A single ZIP or extracted profile directory is still supported. Restart the adapter after changing profiles.

autoAddProfiles.label: Automatically add scanned profiles to the device table
autoAddProfiles.help: New profiles are added as disabled device suggestions. Existing enabled, host and haId values are preserved.

enableMdnsDiscovery.label: Enable mDNS discovery
enableMdnsDiscovery.help: Searches the local network for Home Connect appliances via _homeconnect._tcp.local. Discovery only writes discovery states and does not change device configuration yet.

mdnsDiscoveryTimeout.label: mDNS discovery timeout in seconds
mdnsDiscoveryTimeout.help: How long each Home Connect mDNS discovery scan listens for responses.

autoUpdateDiscoveredHosts.label: Update hosts from discovered appliances
autoUpdateDiscoveredHosts.help: Prepared for a later PR. Currently discovered hosts are only shown in discovery states.

autoAddDiscoveredDevices.label: Add discovered appliances automatically
autoAddDiscoveredDevices.help: Prepared for a later PR. Currently discovered appliances are not added automatically.

enableRawStates.label: Create raw UID states
enableRawStates.help: Creates debug states raw.uid_<uid> with raw Home Connect values.

devices.label: Appliances
devices.help: Only Enabled, Name and IP or host should normally be edited. The other columns are filled from the scanned profile ZIP files.
